title: Enrichment Configuration Guide for Joe Sandbox

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler Deception with Joe Sandbox to enhance events that are generated in the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal with additional context.
Joe Sandbox is a cloud-based malware sandbox that detects and analyzes malware samples. You can send malware files to Joe Sandbox for testing and download reports for further analysis.
Before you configure the enrichment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: Network connectivity from the Deception Admin Portal to the Joe Sandbox API server.
Obtained the Joe Sandbox API key. In the Joe Sandbox console, go to User Settings > API Key to obtain the API key.

blocks.heading: Configuring the Enrichment Integration with Joe Sandbox

blocks.text: To configure the enrichment integration with Joe Sandbox:

blocks.item: Locate Joe Sandbox in the table, and click the Edit icon under the Actions column.
The enrichment integration with Joe Sandbox is enabled.

blocks.text: To test the integration, run an application file on a network decoy with Windows service enabled. When an alert is generated on the Investigate dashboard, send the evidence file to the Joe Sandbox. After you send the evidence file, you can download the report for analysis.
